title: DNSSEC validation in Hickory DNS hickory-net 0.26.0-beta.1 before 0.26.2 and hickory-proto through 0.26.0-alpha.1 does…
description: A vulnerability in DNSSEC validation affects Hickory DNS components hickory-net versions before 0.26.2 and hickory-proto through 0.26.0-alpha.1. The flaw causes the software to incorrectly treat NODATA DNS responses as positive wildcard-expanded responses, allowing an attacker to craft a bogus positive DNS response that passes validation.
